title: Harbor Hank the Pilot Boat and the Loose Float Line
description: Hank steadies a drifting dock float with gentle teamwork, then rests in the moonlit harbor.

Hank.role: Main character; a stout, kind harbor pilot boat
Hank.color: Navy blue hull with a creamy white cabin, pale yellow cabin light, and soft red bumper trim
Hank.bodyShape: Short stout pilot boat with a rounded bow, snug cabin, soft rubber bumpers, and no arms or hands
Hank.face: Large calm blue windshield eyes and a gentle smile on the bow
Hank.wheels: No wheels; floats on water with a small cream wake
Hank.accessories: Pale yellow cabin roof light, silver railings, a coiled soft rope on the deck, and tiny navy life rings on each side

Dot.role: Supporting character; a small sunny dinghy friend
Dot.color: Sunny yellow hull with white seats and sky-blue trim
Dot.bodyShape: Tiny rounded dinghy with no arms or hands
Dot.face: Round green eyes on the bow and a cheerful little smile
Dot.accessories: A small cream paddle rest and a pale blue bow fender

Dock Float.role: Supporting prop; a soft harbor float that drifted loose
Dock Float.appearance: Round red-and-white buoy float with a loose cream line trailing gently; friendly and non-scary

settingBible.Moonlit Harbor: A calm vehicle harbor with wooden docks, soft pilings, warm pier lanterns, gentle waves, and a quiet boat shed
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded forms, clean single-scene compositions, gentle harbor evening colors, and no readable text

continuityRules: Hank keeps the same navy-and-white colors, pale yellow cabin light, blue windshield eyes, soft red bumpers, silver railings, coiled rope, and life rings on every page.
Hank and every boat/vehicle have no human-like arms or hands; help is done with gentle hull bumps and the soft rope.
Dot remains a tiny sunny yellow dinghy with green bow eyes and sky-blue trim.
The dock float is red-and-white; its cream line is loose on Pages 4-9 and secured by Page 11.
The wooden dock and pier lanterns match across pages; water stays calm and bedtime-safe.
The sky progresses from golden evening to lavender dusk, blue twilight, and moonlit night.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, contact sheet, text, badge, logo, or watermark.

pages.text: One calm evening, Harbor Hank the Pilot Boat floated in Moonlit Harbor. His pale yellow cabin light glowed soft.
pages.illustrationScene: Hank floats beside wooden docks at golden evening with pier lanterns and a quiet boat shed behind him.
pages.continuityNotes: Establish Hank's navy hull, cream cabin, pale yellow cabin light, blue eyes, red bumpers, silver railings, coiled rope, and life rings.

pages.text: He began a gentle check of the quiet docks. Little waves tapped the pilings.
pages.illustrationScene: Hank drifts slowly along the dock line while soft waves tap wooden pilings under early evening light.
pages.continuityNotes: Keep Hank locked. Introduce dock and piling geography.

pages.text: Tiny Dot the dinghy bobbed nearby. “Evening, Hank,” she chirped.
pages.illustrationScene: Sunny yellow Dot floats beside Hank's bow near the dock, looking cheerful under soft evening lanterns.
pages.continuityNotes: Introduce Dot's sunny yellow hull, white seats, sky-blue trim, green eyes, and blue bow fender. Scale: Dot much smaller than Hank.

pages.text: Then Hank spotted a problem. A dock float had come loose and drifted a little.
pages.illustrationScene: Hank and Dot look toward a red-and-white buoy float drifting gently away from the dock with a loose cream line trailing.
pages.continuityNotes: Problem: loose float. Keep water calm and non-scary. Float design locked.

pages.text: The cream line trailed in the water. “We need to bring it home,” said Hank.
pages.illustrationScene: Close view of the loose cream line trailing from the red-and-white float while Hank watches carefully nearby.
pages.continuityNotes: Problem continues. Line is loose but gentle. Hank has no arms.

pages.text: Dot nodded. “I can help too,” she said, slow and soft.
pages.illustrationScene: Dot floats beside Hank facing the drifting float under lavender dusk pier lanterns.
pages.continuityNotes: Teamwork offer. Float still slightly adrift. Designs locked.

pages.text: Together they eased closer. Hank used his soft red bumper for a gentle nudge.
pages.illustrationScene: Hank carefully nudges the float with his soft red bow bumper while Dot stays nearby on calm water.
pages.continuityNotes: Help via bumper only—no arms. Float moves gently toward dock.

pages.text: Dot guided the trailing line with her little bow fender. The float turned toward home.
pages.illustrationScene: Dot lightly guides the cream line with her pale blue bow fender as the float turns toward the wooden dock.
pages.continuityNotes: Continue solution. No arms. Water remains calm.

pages.text: Hank uncoiled his soft rope. He looped it ready for a safe hold.
pages.illustrationScene: Hank's coiled soft rope extends from his deck toward the float near the dock pilings under blue twilight.
pages.continuityNotes: Rope used as boat equipment only—no hands. Float nearly at dock.

pages.text: They held the float steady beside the piling. The cream line was almost fixed.
pages.illustrationScene: Hank and Dot hold the red-and-white float steady beside a wooden piling with the cream line nearly in place.
pages.continuityNotes: Nearly resolved. Keep all designs locked. Calm water.

pages.text: The float sat safe and smooth against the dock. The loose line was fixed at last.
pages.illustrationScene: The red-and-white float rests secured against the wooden dock with the cream line neatly held while Hank and Dot smile.
pages.continuityNotes: Problem resolved. Line secured. Same dock geography.

pages.text: Pier lanterns shone on the quiet water. The harbor felt ready for night.
pages.illustrationScene: Wide calm harbor view with the secured float at the dock, Hank and Dot nearby, and warm pier lanterns reflecting on water.
pages.continuityNotes: Show tidy result. Float remains secured. Designs unchanged.

pages.text: Hank coiled his rope again. Dot gave a tiny happy splash.
pages.illustrationScene: Hank's soft rope returns neatly coiled on deck while Dot makes a tiny gentle splash of joy nearby.
pages.continuityNotes: Tools put away. Splashes are tiny and calm, not chaotic.

pages.text: They rested by the boat shed. The moon rose over the still harbor.
pages.illustrationScene: Hank and Dot rest beside the quiet boat shed as a crescent moon rises and pier lanterns glow softly.
pages.continuityNotes: Bedtime transition. Secured float visible in background. Calm mood.

pages.text: That night, Hank rested under the quiet moon. Goodnight, Hank. Goodnight, Dot.
pages.illustrationScene: Hank rests in the moonlit harbor with pale yellow cabin light glowing softly while Dot sleeps nearby and the secured float gleams by the dock.
pages.continuityNotes: Calm bedtime ending. Hank keeps all locked features. Peaceful harbor night.
